parts.title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
parts.summary: Compute the total fuel required to launch all spacecraft modules by applying floor(mass / 3) - 2 (clamped at zero) per module.
parts.algorithmSummary: Polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy (SINGLE_STAGE_FUEL_POLICY for Part 1, pre-built RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY for zero-churn Part 2) in 2019/day01/shared/ (0.21 ms across 100 modules -> 3,474,920): exact BigInt accumulation, bounded cascade trace, interactive SVG stage-cascade visualizer, cross-verified across 0..500, powers-of-3 transitions, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER against a BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre oracle.
learnings: A BigInt shifted base-3 Legendre closed-form oracle independently cross-checks recursive fuel cascades even near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and across '10'-prefix powers-of-3 boundaries.
Injecting a polymorphic FuelPolicy strategy into createFuelSolver keeps Part 1 and Part 2 domain solvers to 4 lines each with zero shared edits.

parts.title: The Tyranny of the Rocket Equation
parts.summary: Compute total spacecraft fuel when each added fuel stage requires additional recursive fuel until floor(mass / 3) - 2 <= 0.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day01/shared/ binding RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY into createFuelSolver (0.36 ms across 100 modules -> 5,209,504): per-module iterative fuel stage cascade, bounded telemetry trace, shared RocketFuelVisualizer with stacked stage-breakdown bars, differentially verified against an independent BigInt recursive oracle across 0..200, powers-of-3 stage-jump boundaries, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.
parts.complexity: O(N log M) time, O(N) parsed storage / O(log M) extra space
learnings: Pre-building RECURSIVE_FUEL_POLICY and multi-stage cascade bars in day01/shared/ reduced Part 2's domain solver to 4 lines with zero shared-module edits.
Computing recursive fuel per module before summing is essential because floor((a + b) / 3) - 2 != (floor(a / 3) - 2) + (floor(b / 3) - 2).

parts.title: 1202 Program Alarm
parts.summary: Restore a gravity-assist Intcode program to the 1202 alarm state (mem[1]=12, mem[2]=2), execute opcodes 1/2/99 until halt, and return mem[0].
parts.algorithmSummary: Reusable year-scoped BigInt Intcode VM in 2019/shared/intcode/ (MemoryAccess DIP, BigInt-first bounds checks, polymorphic OpcodeHandler registry, O(1) StepRecorderContext) powering 2019/day02/shared/alarmRunner.ts (0.50 ms -> 5,098,658): 2-pass bounded traceGravityAssist, interactive SVG tape visualizer, differentially verified against an independent flat-loop oracle across 30 seeded programs plus all 5 raw AoC examples.
learnings: Building a year-scoped reusable BigInt Intcode VM in 2019/shared/intcode/ with MemoryAccess DIP and polymorphic OpcodeHandler prepares Days 5, 7, 9, and 11-25 for clean additive extensions with zero rewrites.
Validating address bounds in BigInt (address < 0n || address >= BigInt(len)) before Number(address) avoids silent IEEE-754 precision collisions at 2^53 + 1 while keeping V8 coverage cleanly at 100%.

parts.title: 1202 Program Alarm
parts.summary: Find the noun and verb in [0..99] that make the gravity-assist Intcode program halt with mem[0] = 19690720, returning 100 * noun + verb.
parts.algorithmSummary: 3-point affine basis probe ((0,0), (1,0), (0,1)) with concrete Intcode VM verification and cached exhaustive [0..99]^2 fallback in 2019/day02/part2/ (0.86 ms in 4 VM runs -> 5,064): zero edits to 2019/shared/intcode/ or day02/shared/, HiDPI canvas log-error heatmap (via shared/core bigintLog2) paired with winning-run TapeGridPanel replay, differentially verified against an independent flat-loop brute-force oracle across 30 seeded affine & non-affine programs.
parts.complexity: O(N + S) affine fast path (4 VM runs); O(R^2 * (N + S)) verified fallback
learnings: A 3-point black-box affine probe verified by a concrete VM execution solves AoC Day 2 Part 2 in 4 VM runs (~0.86 ms) while staying 100% sound on non-affine or self-modifying programs via cached exhaustive fallback.

Mapping absError === 0n -> 0 and positive errors -> bigintLog2(absError) + 1 normalized only when maxLogError > 0 prevents 0/0 NaN and preserves clear visual separation between exact matches (0n) and unit errors (1n).

parts.title: Crossed Wires
parts.summary: Find the Manhattan distance from the central port (0, 0) to the closest non-origin intersection of two orthogonal wire paths.
parts.algorithmSummary: Exact BigInt pairwise segment-intersection geometry in 2019/day03/shared/ with SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC pre-built for zero-churn Part 2 (6.98 ms across 301x301 segments -> 5,357): uses shared/core ClosedInterval.subtract around origin for collinear overlaps, branchless WireSegment.stepsTo, BigInt aspect-preserving HiDPI canvas visualizer, differentially verified across 30 seeded wire pairs against a unit-step grid-walk oracle for both Manhattan and signal-delay metrics.
parts.complexity: O(S1 * S2) time, O(S1 + S2 + K) space
learnings: Splitting collinear overlaps on fixedCoord === 0n via shared/core ClosedInterval.subtract(ORIGIN_INTERVAL) handles all six origin-touch/split regimes in one branchless call.
Updating deduplicated crossing records unconditionally with minBigInt/Math.min avoids unreachable V8 branch traps under lexicographic segment-pair iteration.

parts.title: Crossed Wires
parts.summary: Find the minimum combined step count (signal delay) along both wires to reach any non-origin intersection, using each wire's earliest visit.
parts.algorithmSummary: Zero-churn reuse of 2019/day03/shared/ binding SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC into createCrossedWiresSolver and CrossedWiresVisualizer (7.98 ms across 301x301 segments -> 101,956): earliest-visit BigInt step deduplication across orthogonal and collinear spans, differentially verified across 30 additional seeded PRNG wire pairs (plus symmetric self-crossing and same/opposite collinear traps) against an independent unit-step grid-walk signal-delay oracle.
parts.complexity: O(S1 * S2) time, O(S1 + S2 + K) space
learnings: Pre-building SIGNAL_DELAY_METRIC and earliest-visit minBigInt deduplication in day03/shared/ reduced Part 2's domain solver to 4 lines with zero shared-module edits.
On any collinear overlap segment pair, combined step delay is affine (slope +/-2 or 0), guaranteeing its exact global minimum lies at an overlap endpoint.
